# ADAM v0.42 — Distributed Living Recreation Universe

ADAM v0.42 is a runnable bounded prototype of an atomic universe that recreates digital forms on demand instead of treating complete application objects as permanent authority.

## Main capabilities

- exact atomization and byte-for-byte reconstruction;
- recursive semantic atoms, compounds and bonds;
- distributed majority-certified state and recovery;
- sovereignty-aware erasure placement;
- evidence-aligned multimodal perception;
- inference-closure authorization;
- real Operations One migration and cognition;
- trained demand routing with OOD abstention;
- application and media spawning;
- IoT/robotics capability surfaces;
- novelty-only atomic transfer;
- signed history, tamper rejection and restart recovery.

## Run full qualification

Linux/macOS:

```bash
bash RUN_ADAM_V042_QUALIFICATION.sh
```

Windows PowerShell:

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\RUN_ADAM_V042_QUALIFICATION.ps1
```

## Run the recreation demonstration

```bash
python RUN_LIVING_RECREATION_DEMO.py
```

## Claim boundary

The build proves a bounded exact recreation and governed construction mechanism. It does not prove universal semantic understanding, production WAN/BFT operation, certified physical robot control, a compiled Rust authority kernel, 30 wall-clock days, or production SLAs.
